content.text: The licence provisions meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 13.1 Subject to payment of applicable Fees, Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes and to provide services to Customer.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position on every material term. The subscription grant in 13.1 expressly extends to Customer's Affiliates and to contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice precondition needed), and covers Authorized Users. Paid-up and embedded software under 13.2 is granted on a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid basis to Customer and its Affiliates, with contractor support permitted. Section 13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity, so the licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion, and it permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor in line with the Section 24.1 assignment right (M&A/asset sale without Vendor consent, and 24.4 blocks repricing or termination on change of control). The restrictions in 13.4 are the customary reverse-engineering/security/legality limits and are expressly carved back for authorized security testing and Customer Data and output; Section 12 imposes no narrowing use restrictions. No redline is warranted.
